_about: Recorded 2026-09-29. entries/aliases: the pin15 Library pack's place+zip resolver rows for every n-gram of the labeled asks (so the matcher sees exactly what the pinned pack gives it). buoys: NDBC latest_obs.txt (one fetch) — exact-case ids, measures = columns not MM. points/forecast: api.weather.gov payloads (trimmed) fetched once with the app's honest identity.
